title: Tracker-write decoupling: analyst has no durable expansion-tracker.json write path; EXP-596 entry permanently lost; PROP-029 safety-net routes tinker-addressed signals to a surface tinker never reads
summary: Escalation of attention-inbox item PROP029-ORPHAN-DETECTED-2026-06-07 (now resolved-by-escalation after 3 analyst runs with no tinker acknowledgment). Three findings: (1) EXP-596 (WIN-042 rewrite, ISS-2618) is integrated in data/wins.json and ISS-2618 is closed (fixed_at 2026-06-07T01:07Z), but expansion-tracker.json at origin/main has NO EXP-596 entry — both the decider tracker-write at routing time and the analyst backfill were lost. Decider should backfill a status=integrated entry for audit-trail completeness. (2) Structural root cause: analyst-side tracker writes CANNOT persist by design — analyst is forbidden from git push, its clone is deleted at run end, and expansion-tracker.json is not in the workspace-sync universal-pusher rescue set, so FUSE-side analyst writes are invisible to clone-fresh readers. Fix options: (a) decider backfills tracker entries from analyst issue-proposals at intake (proven working: EXP-600 was backfilled this way on 2026-06-07), or (b) add expansion-tracker.json to the universal-pusher set (riskier: Unclassified multi-writer file; see PROP-065/FND-02 precedent for why mtime-based rescue of multi-writer files is dangerous). Recommend (a) be made the documented standard in the orphan-intake procedure. (3) Routing gap: PROP-029 orphan-detection writes tinker-addressed action items into monitor/analyst/attention-inbox.json, but monitor/prompts/tinker.md has zero references to attention-inbox — verified by grep 2026-06-07. Tinker-addressed signals need a tinker-readable surface (e.g., a soft-complaint sentinel in monitor/integrity/, which tinker greps, or an operator directive).

evidence.tracker_at_origin_main: last ids EXP-592,594,595,593,597,598,599,600 — EXP-596 absent (checked 2026-06-07T11:12:08.777Z via raw.githubusercontent.com)
evidence.exp600_contrast: EXP-600 WAS backfilled into tracker between 07:15Z and this run, via companion proposal-file intake — proving the decider-side backfill path works
evidence.tinker_silence: five tinker reports since item creation (02-40, 06-01, 06-10, 10-01, 10-35 on 2026-06-07) contain zero mentions of PROP029-ORPHAN, ISS-2618, or EXP-596
evidence.tinker_prompt_gap: grep -n attention-inbox monitor/prompts/tinker.md returns no matches

recommended_action: create ISS assigned to tinker for structural fix; decider directly backfills EXP-596 tracker entry (status=integrated, integrated_at 2026-06-07T01:07Z) in same run
